jobs.title: Finance Director (6 month contract)
jobs.description:
This is a 6 month contract with permanent potential at the end of the contract

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.
Assist in preparing for audits, including providing necessary documentation for revenue and payroll audits.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding payroll and revenue recognition.

Process Improvement:
Continuously assess and improve payroll and revenue recognition processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline payroll processing and financial reporting.
Collaborate with IT and software vendors to maintain and optimize payroll and accounting systems.

Skills
Exceptional attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.).

About You

CPA or other relevant certifications preferred.
5+ years of experience in accounting or finance, with a focus on IFRS reporting.
Strong knowledge of IFRS
and experience preparing and reviewing complex financial statements and disclosures.
Experience leading external audits and working effectively with external auditors and other key stakeholders.
Proven experience managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial reporting processes
.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 or equivalent).
Solid understanding of accounting principles and regulatory requirements

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Application Support
jobs.description:
Company Details

Why Berkley?

Berkley Canada is a boutique Specialty and Accident, Health & Travel Insurer that delivers exceptional expertise and service to our broker partners and insureds. Our mission is to be the best for our employees, customers and shareholders. By being the best, we mean generating better experiences and better outcomes for these three stakeholders. In order to achieve this, our strategy is simple; we find the industry expert in a line of business and empower them to better serve that specific niche. We encourage our team to think outside the box, be innovative and create new opportunities. Join us today!

Responsibilities

This role is open to Manager-level or Director-level depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications

Position Summary:

We are looking for an Enterprise Application Support Lead to oversee the configuration, maintenance and ongoing support of Berkley Canada’s core insurance business systems, including underwriting, policy administration and claims platforms. This role serves as a key bridge between insurance business stakeholders, system vendors, and internal technology teams, ensuring core systems continue to meet operational, data and control requirements. The successful candidate will bring strong commercial insurance domain knowledge, experience working with third-party system vendors, and a disciplined approach to system support, change and release management.

Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Berkley Canada’s core insurance systems, including features, configuration, integration points and operational dependencies.
Engage closely with underwriting, claims and operations stakeholders to understand business needs and map these to system functionality and configuration options.
Work with system vendors and implementation partners to interpret requirements, develop implementation approaches, oversee delivery and hold vendors accountable for outcomes.
Track and manage system defects; facilitate prioritization, analysis and development of workarounds; oversee vendor resolution of defects, user acceptance testing and release.
Plan and oversee version upgrade cycles, staying informed of new system features and functionality and determining when and how upgrades should be adopted.
Serve as a subject matter expert for system testing, including development of test plans for new features, defect fixes, regression and integration testing; oversee test execution and sign-off.
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team to ensure changes to core systems appropriately consider downstream data, analytics and reporting requirements.
Establish and promote frameworks, standards and best practices for system super users who manage business configuration and insurance policy issuance.
Establish, document and periodically test controls related to third-party application release management and vendor management.
Own and maintain key vendor relationships related to core insurance applications.

You will also have the chance to...

Make a noticeable impact on a small but growing team where the benefits of your contributions will be highly visible to the rest of the organization.
Draw from resources and expertise available in the wider Berkley Group of companies.
Enjoy a competitive benefits package including a personal budget for professional development.
Join a supportive and empowering company culture that recognizes and values the diversity of our people.
Work flexibly in a hybrid remote/on-site environment.

Qualifications

Characteristics:

2+ years’ proven experience working for an insurance company or Managing General Agent.
Experience working for a commercial property and casualty insurer is strongly preferred.
4+ years’ experience in a lead role supporting business IT systems, including management of application configuration, patch releases and version updates.
5+ years’ experience collaborating with business subject matter experts and system super users defining requirements for system functionality and IT support processes.
Experience working with third-party system vendors, including requirements interpretation, delivery oversight and vendor relationship management.
Solid understanding of system testing disciplines, release management and change control in a regulated environment.
Ability to understand and articulate how system changes impact downstream data, reporting and analytics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable operating in a control-conscious environment.
Collaborative, pragmatic and solution-focused approach.
Post-secondary educational qualification in computer information systems, computer science or business management preferred but not required with relevant work experience.

Thank you for considering Berkley Canada!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Additional Company Details

Berkley Canada offers a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package for full time, regular employees, including:

Base Salary Range: $115,000 - $145,000
Eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus
Comprehensive benefits package, including health and dental coverage, life insurance, STD, LTD, critical illness insurance, EAP, professional development support, vacation, paid time off, and RRSP plan contributions

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and typical maximum target for new hire salaries for this position; it does not reflect the maximum salary for the role over time. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job related skills and experience demonstrated during the interview process.

Berkley Canada does not use AI based screening tools in the hiring process and this posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively hiring to fill.

jobs.title: Director Consulting, Health Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
Position Description

Health Technology & Transformation

CGI is seeking a Director Consulting, Health Technology & Transformation to provide senior technical and health industry leadership across the Atlantic Business Unit.

As one of Canada's largest IT and business consulting services firms, CGI combines strong local client relationships with the scale, industry expertise, delivery capabilities, and intellectual property of a global organization. In this role, you will help connect the needs of Atlantic Canadian health organizations with CGI's national and global health, technology, and delivery capabilities.

Shape Health Solutions. Provide Technical Leadership. Enable Successful Transformation.

As a Director Consulting Expert Health Technology & Transformation, you will serve as a senior technical and solution advisory leader for CGI's health clients and strategic health initiatives across Atlantic Canada.

Working with Directors of Consulting Services, account leaders, architects, delivery leaders, and technology specialists, you will bring deep health sector and technical expertise to strategic client opportunities and complex transformation initiatives.

You will lead technical discovery, solution shaping, technology strategy, architecture alignment, and senior technical assurance, helping CGI convert client priorities into credible, secure, and executable solutions.

You will help clients understand how digital health platforms, enterprise applications, integration, interoperability, data, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and automation can be applied to address their clinical, administrative, and operational priorities.

You will also help CGI develop a more cohesive health technology capability across Atlantic Canada by connecting local client needs with CGI's broader health expertise, reusable assets, delivery capabilities, intellectual property, and alliance partner solutions.

What You'll Bring

Your future duties and responsibilities

Health Technology Advisory

Serve as a senior health technology advisor to client technology leaders, digital health executives, operational leaders, clinical stakeholders, architects, and transformation teams.
Bring the appropriate technical expertise into strategic client discussions and opportunities by collaborating across CGI's account, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams.
Lead technical discovery sessions, current state assessments, architecture reviews, option analyses, and technology roadmap development.
Translate clinical, operational, administrative, and business requirements into practical technology strategies and solution approaches.
Advise clients on digital health modernization, enterprise architecture, interoperability, integration, data platforms, AI adoption, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, automation, and application modernization.
Help clients evaluate technology alternatives, dependencies, risks, implementation considerations, and total cost of ownership.
Ensure recommendations reflect healthcare delivery realities, privacy, security, clinical workflow, data governance, regulatory requirements, and organizational readiness.
Communicate complex technology considerations clearly to technical and non technical stakeholders.

Technical Opportunity Shaping

Partner with account and industry leaders to assess and shape strategic health opportunities.
Provide technical leadership during early opportunity qualification by assessing feasibility, complexity, capability requirements, delivery risks, and potential solution approaches.
Lead or support technical discovery workshops, solutioning sessions, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and architecture discussions.
Develop high level solution architectures, technology roadmaps, implementation approaches, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and risk assessments.
Coordinate input from CGI specialists across digital health, cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, application services, managed services, enterprise platforms, and systems integration.
Connect Atlantic Canadian opportunities with CGI capabilities, accelerators, intellectual property, case studies, delivery centres, and alliance partner technologies.
Ensure proposed solutions are technically credible, differentiated, scalable, secure, and aligned with the client environment.
Provide senior technical input into proposals, presentations, statements of work, business cases, and competitive procurements.
Participate in client presentations and procurement processes as CGI's senior health technology subject matter expert.
Help create a clear transition from opportunity shaping into detailed design, mobilization, and delivery.

Health Architecture and Solution Leadership

Provide architecture and solution leadership across complex health transformation initiatives.
Assess how individual technologies and initiatives fit within a client's enterprise architecture, digital health strategy, and long term operating model.
Guide solution teams in developing integrated architectures spanning applications, data, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and user experience.
Promote interoperability, reuse, scalability, security, maintainability, and alignment with relevant health sector standards.
Provide expertise in health data exchange, integration patterns, APIs, interoperability frameworks, and standards such as HL7 and FHIR where applicable.
Support the modernization and integration of electronic medical record, electronic health record, claims, benefits, case management, scheduling, patient engagement, clinical, and administrative platforms.
Identify technical risks, architecture gaps, capability constraints, and dependencies before they affect implementation.
Help clients avoid isolated technology investments by promoting enterprise level roadmaps and sustainable architecture decisions.

Delivery Assurance and Technical Governance

Provide senior technical oversight for strategic or high risk health engagements.
Support engagement mobilization by validating solution scope, architecture, resource requirements, delivery assumptions, and technical dependencies.
Participate in architecture governance, design reviews, technical risk reviews, and executive steering discussions where appropriate.
Work with delivery leaders to ensure implementation remains aligned with the agreed solution strategy and client outcomes.
Provide escalation support for complex technical, architectural, integration, or health domain issues.
Help delivery teams navigate client technology environments, governance processes, privacy requirements, and health sector constraints.
Review significant solution changes to assess their effect on scope, risk, cost, architecture, and long term maintainability.
Capture lessons learned and reusable technical assets from health engagements.

Capability Development

Help define the health technology capabilities required to support CGI's Atlantic health strategy.
Collaborate with CGI's account, industry, and technology leaders to identify market needs, emerging technology trends, capability gaps, and areas in which CGI can differentiate.
Develop reusable health technology assets, reference architectures, assessment methods, solution patterns, demonstrations, and points of view.
Connect Atlantic teams with CGI health experts, architects, delivery centres, and technology practices across Canada and globally.
Mentor architects, consultants, and technical team members working within the health portfolio.
Help improve health industry fluency among CGI's technical teams and technology fluency among CGI's health consulting and account teams.
Support the identification and development of technical talent required for current and future health opportunities.
Represent CGI in health technology forums, industry working groups, technical conferences, and partner discussions as appropriate.
Maintain current knowledge of health technology developments, emerging standards, cybersecurity threats, platform capabilities, and industry leading practices.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Twelve or more years of experience in health technology consulting, digital health, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, systems integration, technology transformation, or a related field.
Significant experience working within or advising the Canadian healthcare sector.
Demonstrated experience designing, shaping, or overseeing complex technology solutions in healthcare or another highly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of healthcare delivery environments and the relationship between clinical, operational, administrative, and technology requirements.
Experience leading technical discovery, architecture assessments, technology roadmaps, option analyses, and solution design activities.
Broad technical knowledge across digital health platforms, enterprise and solution architecture, systems integration and interoperability, health data and analytics, AI and intelligent automation, cloud, cybersecurity, application modernization, and enterprise platforms.
Understanding of health interoperability concepts, integration patterns, APIs, and applicable standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Experience contributing to proposals, requests for proposal, statements of work, estimates, technical presentations, and competitive pursuits.
Ability to assess technical feasibility, solution complexity, delivery risk, architecture alignment, and capability requirements.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business, clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business development, account management, architecture, consulting, delivery, and technology teams.
Ability to provide technical leadership without needing to personally design or build every component of a solution.
A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Health Informatics, Health Administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to obtain any reliability or security clearances required by CGI clients.
Willingness to travel within Atlantic Canada and elsewhere in Canada as required.

Key Assets

Experience working with a Canadian provincial health system, health authority, healthcare provider, payer, insurer, government health department, health benefits organization, or professional health association.
Experience with electronic health records, electronic medical records, health information exchange, claims and benefits platforms, clinical systems, patient engagement platforms, or digital front door solutions.
Experience modernizing complex legacy environments involving multiple vendors, platforms, integration technologies, and data sources.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud in regulated or health sector environments.
Experience with data platforms, analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, Responsible AI, and AI governance in healthcare.
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture governance, technology portfolio management, and modernization roadmaps.
Familiarity with Canadian health information privacy, security, data residency, and information governance requirements.
Experience working with major health technology vendors, enterprise application providers, or cloud and platform partners.
Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, cloud, cybersecurity, data, AI, project delivery, or health informatics.
A graduate degree in Health Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Health Administration, or a related field.

.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Solutions Architecture — Americas
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

As the Senior Director of Solutions Architecture for the Americas at Cohere, you will own the US and Canada commercial Solutions Architecture function. You will lead the team that turns enterprise interest in agentic AI into deployed, production systems, and you will be accountable for the technical win in the most competitive AI market in the world. The United States and Canada are our largest commercial opportunity, and this seat owns how we win them.

You will take an established, distributed team of strong technical people and raise what it can do — setting the bar and establishing the operating rhythm that lets a team of generalists run consistent, industry-fluent plays at enterprise scale. You will set direction for the function, sit on the Solution Architecture leadership team alongside the regional leaders for EMEA and Asia Pacific, and contribute to company-wide decisions with your peers across Sales, Product and Engineering.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and Scale the Organization: Build, coach and develop a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across the US and Canada, and grow the senior technical talent within it.
Own the Technical Win: Be personally accountable for the technical outcome of the region’s most strategic pursuits, and be in the room for the ones that decide the year.
Own the US Market: Lead how Cohere positions, proves and sells into US enterprises — our largest commercial opportunity, and the market this seat is measured on.
Extend Our Reach: Grow the share of the region’s pipeline the team is technically leading, and make sure we are engaged early on the opportunities that matter most.
Own the Number with Sales: Partner with regional Sales leadership as a co-owner of the region’s number, not as a support function to it.
Set Direction for the Function: Define the vision, strategy and operating model for Americas Solutions Architecture, and hold your leaders accountable for delivery and execution against it.
Build Repeatable Solution Practices: Establish scalable solution-selling methodologies, industry playbooks, executive narratives, business cases and technical delivery frameworks that improve consistency and win rates.
Architect Enterprise AI Solutions: Guide customers in designing secure, scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions across cloud, hybrid, VPC and on-premises environments.
Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback and market needs into platform improvements and roadmap priorities.
Attract Talent to Cohere: Bring senior technical field talent with you and continue to attract it. Building the bench is part of the job, not a consequence of it.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Americas commercial Solutions Architecture team through coaching, hiring, performance management and career development.
Partner with regional Sales leadership to pursue and close strategic enterprise opportunities across financial services, healthcare, energy, technology and other key verticals.
Own the region’s technical coverage model, and ensure the team is engaged early and consistently on the opportunities that matter most.
Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, solution presentations and technical deep dives with C-suite and senior customer stakeholders.
Develop business cases, solution architectures, implementation roadmaps and technical proposals that align customer objectives with Cohere’s platform.
Guide customers through the deployment of enterprise AI solutions, ensuring scalability, security, governance and operational readiness.
Create repeatable solution assets, industry playbooks and best practices that enable the team to consistently deliver high-quality customer engagements.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to ensure alignment between customer needs and platform evolution, and contribute to decisions that reach beyond your own function.
Serve as the voice of the field by capturing customer feedback and competitive insights that influence product strategy.
Own and report on the region’s operational and commercial metrics, including technical win rates, pipeline health, coverage and team performance.

What We’re Looking For

Leadership Experience: 15+ years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting or Enterprise Architecture, including 7+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, and a record of developing people into senior and leadership roles.
People Leadership: A proven record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams, and of building or transforming an organization rather than inheriting a healthy one.
Executive Presence: You command a room. You are credible in front of a CEO and their business leaders, the people who own the problem and the budget, and equally credible in front of a Chief Information Officer, a Chief AI Officer or a Chief Information Security Officer. You can move between the business case and the architecture without losing either audience.
Hands-On Technical Credibility: You are technical enough to be believed by a strong engineering bench. You work with models and agents yourself, you can pressure-test your team’s architecture, and you can be the most useful person in a design conversation when it matters. This is a player-coach seat, not an overlay.
Commercial Acumen: A demonstrated ability to partner with enterprise Sales leadership, influence strategic deals, and articulate business value to executive stakeholders. You have carried a number and can point to deals you personally moved.
Consulting Mindset: Experience leading complex enterprise solution engagements, developing business cases, implementation plans and executive-ready recommendations.
Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, hybrid and on-premises deployments, security and governance.
Enterprise Experience: Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions in complex, regulated or large-scale environments.
Cross-Functional Influence: A record of contributing to decisions beyond your own function, and of working effectively with Product and Engineering leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or turning around a regional technical field organization, and evidence of what changed as a result.
Background in enterprise AI, cloud, or data platform companies, or applied AI consulting organizations.
Experience supporting customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, or the public sector.
Experience building repeatable solution-selling methodologies and helping generalist technical teams operate at a consistently high level.
A network of senior technical field talent you can attract to Cohere.
Experience operating in high-growth environments where speed, ownership and cross-functional collaboration are critical.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work

Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: AVP, Corporate Underwriting Risk & Governance
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

About The Role

The Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance is accountable for maintaining the organization's underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, technical standards, and governance framework across all life and health insurance businesses. The role serves as a corporate risk subject matter expert on mortality, morbidity, product, underwriting, and fraud risks, providing underwriting risk management guidance to business units globally, with particular emphasis on emerging risks, high-net-worth markets, and the impact of underwriting and product design decisions on long-term business performance.

The incumbent will lead the evaluation and approval of underwriting and product-related risk initiatives, assess the mortality and morbidity implications of underwriting requirement changes, product innovations, and distribution strategies, and ensure alignment with corporate risk management objectives, with primary focus on our Asia business units and Private Wealth business. The role provides technical leadership to underwriters and input to actuarial, product development, and risk management teams on underwriting-specific risk while championing sound underwriting practices, risk governance, and sustainable growth.

Operating in a highly collaborative, consultative, and project-oriented environment, the Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance will lead complex initiatives across the Asia business units and jurisdictions, influence business unit underwriting leadership and risk management decision-making, and represent the organization on underwriting and insurance industry matters under the direction of the Corporate Chief Underwriter.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Underwriting Governance

Support and champion corporate underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and underwriting governance standards.
Provide enterprise oversight of underwriting practices across life, health, critical illness, disability, and medical reimbursement products.
Evaluate proposed changes to underwriting requirements, underwriting evidence, accelerated underwriting programs, automation initiatives, and digital underwriting solutions.
Assess and communicate the mortality and morbidity implications associated with underwriting and product design changes.

Mortality and Morbidity Risk Management

Evaluate mortality and morbidity risks associated with existing and proposed products, underwriting methodologies, and distribution strategies.
Assess the impact of product features, underwriting evidence requirements, and benefit structures on expected mortality and morbidity outcomes.
Partner with actuarial, product, and risk management teams to monitor emerging experience trends and recommend mitigation strategies.
Provide technical leadership on mortality and morbidity risk management across multiple markets.

Product and Anti-Selection Risk Assessment

Assess product design features for anti-selection, fraud, claims, and sustainability risks.
Identify underwriting controls, medical requirements, and risk management measures necessary to mitigate adverse selection and fraud exposure.
Provide risk guidance during new product development and product enhancement activities.
Evaluate the potential impact of product design changes on underwriting outcomes and claims experience.

Fraud Risk Oversight

Identify emerging fraud risks and vulnerabilities within underwriting and product frameworks.
Recommend underwriting, medical, and operational controls designed to mitigate fraud exposure.
Partner with claims, investigations, and risk management teams to identify trends and strengthen preventive measures.

High
-
Net
-
Worth and Complex Risk Expertise

Provide technical leadership on high-net-worth and Private Wealth underwriting practices, particularly within Asian markets.
Evaluate large face amount and complex financial underwriting cases.
Monitor market developments and emerging risk trends impacting high-net-worth and Private Wealth business.
Support business units in developing prudent underwriting strategies for complex and high-exposure risks.

Retention and Reinsurance Management

Provide leadership and guidance regarding retention management practices.
Evaluate retention limits, concentration risk, and reinsurance effectiveness.
Partner with reinsurance stakeholders as permitted to ensure alignment between underwriting strategies and risk transfer objectives.

Strategic Leadership

Lead complex cross-functional underwriting initiatives involving multiple business units, jurisdictions, and product lines.
Influence senior leaders and business partners on underwriting, mortality, morbidity, and product risk matters.
Provide strategic recommendations balancing growth opportunities with responsible risk management.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Corporate Chief Underwriter on emerging underwriting and insurance risks.

Technical Thought Leadership

Research emerging medical, underwriting, product, and industry developments.
Participate in the development and maintenance of underwriting manuals, medical guidelines, and risk assessment standards.
Translate emerging medical evidence and industry research into practical underwriting guidance.
Represent the organization externally through industry associations, conferences, forums, and professional organizations.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Minimum 15 years of progressive life and health underwriting experience.
Minimum 5 years holding an individual underwriting approval authority of at least $30 million (preferred).
Significant experience assessing complex mortality and morbidity risks.
Experience underwriting high-net-worth and large face amount business, including exposure to Asian insurance markets.
Demonstrated experience evaluating underwriting implications of life, health, disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and medical reimbursement products.
Proven experience leading complex underwriting, governance, or risk initiatives across multiple business units or jurisdictions.
Experience working with reinsurance and retention management frameworks.
Experience developing underwriting philosophy, guidelines, manuals, and risk governance standards.
Proven ability to influence business risk management and underwriting leaders.
Strong strategic thinking and risk assessment capabilities.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment focused on governance, consultation, project leadership, innovation, and enterprise risk oversight rather than production underwriting activities.

Preferred Designations

FALU
FLMI
Additional designations in risk management, supplemental health, or related disciplines.

What's In It For You

Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
In 2024, Sun Life ranked among the top 100 most sustainable global corporations by Corporate Knights for the 15th consecutive year, leading Canadian insurers.
We are proud to be on the 2024 Best Workplaces in Canada list by Great Place to Work.
We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Solutions Architecture — Americas
new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

As the Senior Director of Solutions Architecture for the Americas at Cohere, you will own the US and Canada commercial Solutions Architecture function. You will lead the team that turns enterprise interest in agentic AI into deployed, production systems, and you will be accountable for the technical win in the most competitive AI market in the world. The United States and Canada are our largest commercial opportunity, and this seat owns how we win them.

You will take an established, distributed team of strong technical people and raise what it can do — setting the bar and establishing the operating rhythm that lets a team of generalists run consistent, industry-fluent plays at enterprise scale. You will set direction for the function, sit on the Solution Architecture leadership team alongside the regional leaders for EMEA and Asia Pacific, and contribute to company-wide decisions with your peers across Sales, Product and Engineering.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and Scale the Organization: Build, coach and develop a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across the US and Canada, and grow the senior technical talent within it.
Own the Technical Win: Be personally accountable for the technical outcome of the region’s most strategic pursuits, and be in the room for the ones that decide the year.
Own the US Market: Lead how Cohere positions, proves and sells into US enterprises — our largest commercial opportunity, and the market this seat is measured on.
Extend Our Reach: Grow the share of the region’s pipeline the team is technically leading, and make sure we are engaged early on the opportunities that matter most.
Own the Number with Sales: Partner with regional Sales leadership as a co-owner of the region’s number, not as a support function to it.
Set Direction for the Function: Define the vision, strategy and operating model for Americas Solutions Architecture, and hold your leaders accountable for delivery and execution against it.
Build Repeatable Solution Practices: Establish scalable solution-selling methodologies, industry playbooks, executive narratives, business cases and technical delivery frameworks that improve consistency and win rates.
Architect Enterprise AI Solutions: Guide customers in designing secure, scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions across cloud, hybrid, VPC and on-premises environments.
Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback and market needs into platform improvements and roadmap priorities.
Attract Talent to Cohere: Bring senior technical field talent with you and continue to attract it. Building the bench is part of the job, not a consequence of it.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Americas commercial Solutions Architecture team through coaching, hiring, performance management and career development.
Partner with regional Sales leadership to pursue and close strategic enterprise opportunities across financial services, healthcare, energy, technology and other key verticals.
Own the region’s technical coverage model, and ensure the team is engaged early and consistently on the opportunities that matter most.
Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, solution presentations and technical deep dives with C-suite and senior customer stakeholders.
Develop business cases, solution architectures, implementation roadmaps and technical proposals that align customer objectives with Cohere’s platform.
Guide customers through the deployment of enterprise AI solutions, ensuring scalability, security, governance and operational readiness.
Create repeatable solution assets, industry playbooks and best practices that enable the team to consistently deliver high-quality customer engagements.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to ensure alignment between customer needs and platform evolution, and contribute to decisions that reach beyond your own function.
Serve as the voice of the field by capturing customer feedback and competitive insights that influence product strategy.
Own and report on the region’s operational and commercial metrics, including technical win rates, pipeline health, coverage and team performance.

What We’re Looking For

Leadership Experience: 15+ years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting or Enterprise Architecture, including 7+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, and a record of developing people into senior and leadership roles.
People Leadership: A proven record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams, and of building or transforming an organization rather than inheriting a healthy one.
Executive Presence: You command a room. You are credible in front of a CEO and their business leaders, the people who own the problem and the budget, and equally credible in front of a Chief Information Officer, a Chief AI Officer or a Chief Information Security Officer. You can move between the business case and the architecture without losing either audience.
Hands-On Technical Credibility: You are technical enough to be believed by a strong engineering bench. You work with models and agents yourself, you can pressure-test your team’s architecture, and you can be the most useful person in a design conversation when it matters. This is a player-coach seat, not an overlay.
Commercial Acumen: A demonstrated ability to partner with enterprise Sales leadership, influence strategic deals, and articulate business value to executive stakeholders. You have carried a number and can point to deals you personally moved.
Consulting Mindset: Experience leading complex enterprise solution engagements, developing business cases, implementation plans and executive-ready recommendations.
Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, hybrid and on-premises deployments, security and governance.
Enterprise Experience: Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions in complex, regulated or large-scale environments.
Cross-Functional Influence: A record of contributing to decisions beyond your own function, and of working effectively with Product and Engineering leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or turning around a regional technical field organization, and evidence of what changed as a result.
Background in enterprise AI, cloud, or data platform companies, or applied AI consulting organizations.
Experience supporting customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, or the public sector.
Experience building repeatable solution-selling methodologies and helping generalist technical teams operate at a consistently high level.
A network of senior technical field talent you can attract to Cohere.
Experience operating in high-growth environments where speed, ownership and cross-functional collaboration are critical.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work

Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
